title: Depth under remapping
statement: Let $g$ be a Boolean circuit gate, let $ds,ds'$ be lists of natural numbers, and let $[?]$ be a map from natural numbers to natural numbers. Suppose that for every argument $a$ of $g$, the defaulted lookup in $ds$ at index $[?](a)$ is at most the defaulted lookup in $ds'$ at index $a$, plus $1$. Then the depth of the remapped gate computed from $ds$ is at most the depth of $g$ computed from $ds'$, plus $1$.
